describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): record the parser decision, ownership, reuse and lineage (#812)

rule: Each case names its input, the required and forbidden outcomes, the rules it exercises, the existing evidence that already pins part of it, and the node whose test makes it executable. CMP0 adds no test; the owner's test must fail against the planted wrong implementation the case names.

cases.name: Framework option isolation
cases.input: One Vue product and one Svelte product compiled under a baseline; then only svelte.runes changes; then only vue.delimiters changes
cases.required: The Svelte change leaves every Vue key (ParseKey through TerminalKey) equal and re-keys only Svelte keys from SemanticKey on; the Vue change re-keys only Vue keys from ParseKey on
cases.forbidden: A shared profile hash or bundled key that re-keys the other framework's products
cases.plantedWrong: Fold every framework option into one request-wide hash (the current compile_profile_hash shape)

cases.name: Map encoding never invalidates semantics
cases.input: One Vue runtime product compiled with runtimeSourceMap off, then on, then with a different map serialization encoding
cases.required: ParseKey, SemanticKey, CompileStructureKey and TargetPlanKey stay equal; MapMode re-keys EmitKey and TerminalKey; serialization re-keys TerminalKey only
cases.forbidden: Any earlier key changing with map demand or encoding
cases.plantedWrong: Put runtime_source_map into the semantic option bytes

cases.name: Product independence
cases.input: A RuntimeClient request, then the same request plus an IdeCompanion product
cases.required: Every RuntimeClient key is equal across the two requests; shared prefix work runs once
cases.forbidden: One request-wide key, or the IDE product's options entering the runtime chain
cases.plantedWrong: Derive SemanticKey from the whole product set

cases.name: No ignored field on any route
cases.input: A Vue request setting each unread row of the classification (for example whitespace or cacheHandlers), sent through the standalone route, the host integration route, NAPI, WASM, FFI and verter-tsc
cases.required: Every route returns the same typed Unsupported naming the written request field, or every route honours the option in its class
cases.forbidden: One route refusing while another admits and ignores; output that silently ignores an accepted field
cases.plantedWrong: Keep the refusal list in the host integration only

cases.name: Optimized cannot execute
cases.required: Unsupported(Optimized); zero parse, semantic, plan and emit work by the work ledger; no stage key minted; no cache write
cases.forbidden: Falling back to Default, or running any stage before refusing
cases.plantedWrong: Map Optimized onto the Default contract

cases.name: No ambient default identity
cases.input: Default for a framework whose installed release is not an admitted exact release; a request naming latest or a range
cases.forbidden: Coercing to the nearest or newest admitted release; a family-wide version switch
cases.plantedWrong: Resolve Default to the newest registry row
existingEvidence: tests/cases/capability_matrix_compile_request_coverage.rs (VUE-OTHER-VERSION and SVELTE-OTHER-VERSION are documented exemptions today)

cases.name: No display strings in identity
cases.input: Two equal typed inputs whose Debug renderings differ (field order, a renamed variant) and two different inputs whose Debug renderings coincide
cases.required: Keys follow the canonical typed fields, not the rendering
cases.forbidden: Debug, Display, serde_json, a std Hasher or a timestamp feeding a key

cases.name: Unclassified option
cases.input: A new framework request field added without a classification row
cases.required: The build fails (exhaustive match) or admission refuses the field
cases.forbidden: The field admitted with no class
cases.plantedWrong: A wildcard arm in the classifier
existingEvidence: compile_request vue/svelte tests vue_option_classification_counts_match_the_committed_tsv and svelte_option_classification_counts_match_the_committed_tsv (support class, not impact class)

cases.name: Degraded outcomes never warm
cases.input: A request that returns NeedInputs; one cancelled mid-emit; one that exceeds its budget; then the complete request
cases.required: Nothing is published under any stage key for the degraded attempts; the complete request computes and equals a fresh compile
cases.forbidden: A partial or NeedInputs result addressable by a key
cases.plantedWrong: Publish the semantic admission before NeedInputs returns

cases.name: Compile-structure regions never alias RegionId
cases.input: Two compile structures of one source unit built for two targets
cases.required: Their snapshot-local region ids may coincide numerically but never enter a key, a DemandSet entry, a segment anchor or a qualifier; only VID0 RegionId crosses a stage
cases.forbidden: A structure-local id spelled or serialized as RegionId
cases.plantedWrong: Anchor an EmissionSegment by an arena index

cases.name: Qualified artifacts never alias
cases.input: One Vue unit compiled as RuntimeClient under the VDOM target and under the Vapor target
cases.required: The two artifacts carry different ArtifactQualifiers; a host map keyed by qualifier keeps both
cases.forbidden: Addressing an artifact by ArtifactId alone
cases.plantedWrong: Key the host artifact map by ArtifactId

cases.name: No family-wide framework switch
cases.input: A request attempting to select a framework major or compatibility mode by a family flag
cases.required: No such field exists; compatibility rows stay refused (compatConfig, compatibilityComponentApi)
cases.forbidden: A vue2/vue3 or svelte4/svelte5 switch on the request
cases.plantedWrong: Add a compat flag that changes the release

cases.name: One field per fact
cases.input: vue.ssr=false with a RuntimeServer product; svelte.dev=true with isProduction=true; componentId on a Svelte request
cases.required: The duplicate fields no longer exist, or admission refuses the contradiction on every route
cases.plantedWrong: Read vue.ssr on one route and the product on another

cases.name: Demanded regions discriminate SemanticKey
cases.input: One source file. Product A demands only its template region. Product B demands that template region and its script region. Parse inputs are otherwise equal.
cases.required: Both products have the same sorted ParseKey set, one ParseKey for the file. Their SemanticKeys differ because SemanticAdmissionBasis field 1, the demanded RegionId set, differs.
cases.forbidden: Equal SemanticKeys whenever the ParseKey sets are equal
cases.plantedWrong: Compose SemanticKey from the sorted ParseKey set and leave the demanded region set out of SemanticAdmissionBasis

cases.name: Equal requests, equal keys
cases.input: Two requests equal up to set-member order and duplicates (isCustomElement) and object key order on the wire
cases.forbidden: Order- or duplicate-sensitive keys for set-like values

cases.name: Default is exact
cases.input: A Vue runtime request with public Default, and the same for Svelte
cases.required: Admission records DefaultCompilationContractId whose ReleaseId is the activation record of the workspace the request is served for (VID0 I04, R08, R09), the same source FrameworkProfileId reads, plus target and contract revision, in provenance. At the described head that activation is @vue/compiler-sfc 3.6.0-rc.5 for Vue and svelte 5.56.10 for Svelte. Those versions are that head's workspace activation, not a build-time pin of the compiler. Its stage epochs enter the keys. A later activation re-resolution re-issues the registry row; the previous id does not stay in force.
cases.forbidden: An implicit or display-string contract identity; copying the frozen capability-matrix compatibility_domain cell (core@3.6.0-rc.3, svelte@5.56.8) into the contract id; reading the compiler binary's dependency pin instead of the served workspace's activation record
existingEvidence: packages/framework-conformance-harness/evidence/version-domain.md (the matrix cell stays frozen on its own package and is not the lock pin)

cases.name: Stage chaining is minimal
cases.input: Change only runtimeModuleName (Emit); then only hoistStatic (TargetPlan); then only propsDestructure (Semantic)
cases.required: Only the keys from the option's class onward change; earlier keys and their cached work are reused
cases.forbidden: Re-parsing or re-analysing for an Emit-class change

cases.name: NeedInputs resumes on the same basis
cases.input: A Vue runtime request with styleProcessing authored-only and a SCSS block; then the same request with the supplied style stage
cases.required: First NeedInputs naming the region and dialect; then Admitted with keys equal to a request that carried the input from the start
cases.forbidden: Re-running parse or semantic work on resume; publishing the first attempt

cases.name: Incremental equals fresh
cases.input: Edit an option, edit the source, revert both, in every order
cases.required: Each warm result equals a fresh compile; a revert restores the earlier keys
cases.forbidden: A stale warm hit after an option change

workCounters.counter: semantic admissions per SemanticKey per request
workCounters.baselineRelation: one per distinct SemanticKey; zero on resume after NeedInputs

workCounters.counter: target plans per TargetPlanKey, emits per EmitKey, map segments under NoMap
workCounters.baselineRelation: one per distinct key; zero map segments under NoMap

workCounters.counter: work of refused requests (Optimized, Unsupported, unsupported-version)
workCounters.baselineRelation: zero parse, semantic, plan and emit work
